mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_file SET carried_from_file_id = NULL WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND carried_from_file_id IS NOT NULL

UPDATE analysis_file n SET carried_from_file_id = o.file_id FROM analysis_file o WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND o.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND o.path = n.path AND o.checksum = n.checksum AND o.language IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.language AND o.file_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.file_type AND o.module IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.module AND o.encoding IS NOT DISTINCT FROM n.encoding
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_file_pass (file_id, pass, revision_id, status, error_message, carried) SELECT n.file_id, p.pass, n.revision_id, p.status, p.error_message, TRUE FROM analysis_file n JOIN analysis_file_pass p ON p.file_id = n.carried_from_file_id WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND p.status = 'DONE' AND p.pass IN #{pass} ON CONFLICT (file_id, pass) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, carried = TRUE, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT quote_ident(column_name) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = #{table} AND column_name NOT IN ('revision_id', 'file_id') AND (column_default IS NULL OR column_default NOT LIKE 'nextval%') ORDER BY ordinal_position
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${table} t USING analysis_file n, analysis_file_pass p WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id IS NOT NULL AND p.file_id = n.file_id AND p.pass = #{pass} AND p.carried AND t.file_id = n.file_id
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_file n SET parse_status = o.parse_status , parse_error = o.parse_error , language_level = o.language_level , package_name = o.package_name , source_root = o.source_root FROM analysis_file o, analysis_file_pass p WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND o.file_id = n.carried_from_file_id AND p.file_id = n.file_id AND p.pass = 'DECLARE' AND p.carried
mapper.insert: WITH touched_file AS ( SELECT n.file_id, 'NEW' AS side FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.file_id, 'OLD' FROM analysis_file o WHERE o.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id = o.file_id) ), touched_id AS ( SELECT s.symbol_id AS id FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN touched_file t ON t.file_id = s.file_id UNION SELECT m.method_id FROM analysis_method m JOIN touched_file t ON t.file_id = m.file_id UNION SELECT f.field_id FROM analysis_field f JOIN touched_file t ON t.file_id = f.file_id ), touched_name AS ( SELECT s.simple_name AS name FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN touched_file t ON t.file_id = s.file_id AND t.side = 'NEW' UNION SELECT m.name FROM analysis_method m JOIN touched_file t ON t.file_id = m.file_id AND t.side = 'NEW' UNION SELECT f.name FROM analysis_field f JOIN touched_file t ON t.file_id = f.file_id AND t.side = 'NEW' ), affected AS ( SELECT r.file_id FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND r.file_id IS NOT NULL AND r.to_id IN (SELECT id FROM touched_id) UNION SELECT ref.file_id FROM analysis_reference ref WHERE ref.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND ref.status IN ('EXTERNAL', 'HEURISTIC', 'UNRESOLVED') AND ref.name IN (SELECT name FROM touched_name) ) INSERT INTO analysis_file_pass (file_id, pass, revision_id, status, error_message, carried) SELECT n.file_id, 'RESOLVE', n.revision_id, 'DONE', NULL, TRUE FROM analysis_file n JOIN analysis_file_pass p ON p.file_id = n.carried_from_file_id AND p.pass = 'RESOLVE' AND p.status = 'DONE' JOIN analysis_file_pass d ON d.file_id = n.file_id AND d.pass = 'DECLARE' AND d.carried WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id NOT IN (SELECT file_id FROM affected) ON CONFLICT (file_id, pass) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, carried = TRUE, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_reference ref SET status = 'PENDING', fail_reason = NULL FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id IS NOT NULL AND ref.file_id = n.file_id AND ref.status <> 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis_file_pass p WHERE p.file_id = n.file_id AND p.pass = 'RESOLVE' AND p.carried)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId}) AS "files" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id IS NOT NULL) AS "unchangedFiles" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis_file o WHERE o.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND o.path = n.path)) AS "changedFiles" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.carried_from_file_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis_file o WHERE o.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND o.path = n.path)) AS "addedFiles" , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file o WHERE o.revision_id = #{baseRevisionId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis_file n WHERE n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.path = o.path)) AS "removedFiles"

SELECT p.pass AS "pass" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.carried) AS "carriedFiles" , COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.carried) AS "analyzedFiles" FROM analysis_file_pass p WHERE p.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND p.pass IN ('DECLARE', 'RESOURCE', 'RESOLVE') GROUP BY p.pass ORDER BY p.pass
